title: JMF Survey — Multi-Tenant SNA Platform
summary: Custom PHP 8.1, MongoDB, and Vanilla JavaScript platform powering sociometric peer-nomination surveys and weighted N×N adjacency matrix exports across enterprise clients.
impact: ~4,000 concurrent respondents · ~3 DB round trips per survey · 5 SNA export pipelines
problem: Standard survey tools cannot visually disambiguate rosters of thousands of employees with headshots, capture order-weighted peer rankings, or generate square N×N directed graph matrices.
solution: Engineered a custom PHP 8.1 MVC backend with multi-tenant MongoDB isolation, browser-offloaded roster search/caching, cloud headshot storage, chunked Excel ingestion, and batch matrix exports.

title: Family Captions — Reunion Oral History App
summary: Elevated my father-in-law Chris's reunion prototype into a resilient multi-user React + Express + node:sqlite platform preserving stories behind 20,000+ family photos—and sparking this portfolio's Neo-Brutalism.
impact: 20,000+ archive scale · 4-table SQLite WAL schema with audit history · Streaming ZIP + .txt exports
problem: Older relatives at a summer reunion needed a zero-login mobile workflow to caption decades-old photographs without risking direct iCloud exposure or erasing conflicting memories.
solution: Built a UUID-anchored Temporary Work Surface combining macOS Apple Photos export scripts, cross-platform Sharp browser uploads, transactional caption_history snapshots, WCAG-hardened Neo-Brutalist UI, and streaming ZIP archives.

title: MLPP Glossary & Data Audit — mayanlanguages.wiki
role: Web Development Intern · Mayan Language Preservation Project
summary: Core engineering on the MLPP glossary infrastructure—combining complete frontend redesign and HTML simplification with Drupal modules, Custom Views Bulk Operations, and dynamic backend translation tracking.
impact: Restored accurate backend metrics · Enabled Views translation % tracking · Modernized frontend UX
problem: Breaking empty HTML tags caused blank backend reporting metrics, while outdated frontend templates and missing Views math hid live translation and media completion percentages.
solution: Cleared breaking empty HTML markup with Custom Views Bulk Operations, redesigned the frontend UI with simplified HTML, and engineered Views percentage calculations for language statistics and media auditing.

title: ElizaPlaybill — Interactive Birthday Booklet
summary: Turned a birthday card for my Broadway-loving partner (now my wife) into a 7-page horizontal swipe Playbill SPA engineered from zero in Semantic HTML5, SCSS, Vanilla ES6 JS, and JSON tributes.
impact: ~4.1 KB Vanilla JS · ~4.8 KB CSS · Zero AI or templates · Hosted free on Render
problem: Physical card-making constraints made it tough to weave heartfelt tributes from friends alongside insider Broadway details and interactive keepsake moments.
solution: Adopted Broadway Playbill visual grammar as a strict spec featuring dual-axis scroll isolation, tap-vs-swipe touch disambiguation, a decoupled messages.json tribute store, and a cache-safe photo carousel.

solution: Partnered with stakeholders to clarify information flows and wrote a bespoke WordPress template from scratch adhering to modern responsive and semantic HTML standards.
